title: “Jikji”, a treasure of the world of printing
version: Dated not specified in preserved source metadata. Institutional description, BnF Coréen 109.
lineage: Custodian account of the 1377 artifact and a distinct 1378 edition. Relevant complete page sections inspected. No original type casting, first-ever priority, metal alloy, print-run or institutional transfer inferred. The two editions are not linked as a technological succession.

passages.locator: A treasure of humanity, paragraph 1; web line 160
passages.note: The surviving volume is attributed to printing at Heungdeok-sa, Cheongju, in 1377.

passages.locator: What is Jikji?, paragraph 1; web line 154
passages.quote: A xylograph version of the complete text of Jikji dated from 1378
passages.note: The page identifies the Ch’wi’am monastery woodblock edition preserved in Korea and the surviving second volume at BnF.
